instruction: Open reminder.docx on the desktop to check the submission requirements. Arrange the sheets in the workbook in alphabetical order: Beans, Millet, Millet spatial integration, Mkt Gotheye, Mkt Mangaize, Mkt Ouallam, Mkt Tera, Raw_data, ReadMe, Sorghum.

Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the full requirement (all sheets in correct alphabetical order)
